profile.headline: University of Puerto Rico, Río Piedras

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Every week we spend two hours of recitation, reinforcing the topics learned in lectures and working though exercises to help them understand the previous topics. We hold four hours of office hours to help them with questions about the course topics, homework’s or projects. We spend 1 hour of weekly meeting with the course instructor and other TAs to discuss progress in recitation and content preparation.

positions.title: IT Academy Programming Instructor
positions.description: During my period with the foundation, I was assigned the task of introducing programming languages to high school students. Developed course content that helped the students acquire different Microsoft Offices Certifications.
